defect: The instruction says an existing pytest suite can be run, but the image contains no /tests/test_outputs.py and no pytest executable.
evidence: instruction.md step 4 conflicts with environment/Dockerfile; attempts 01-12 all had to create their own /tests/test_outputs.py or otherwise reconstruct tests before validation.
change: Install pinned pytest and copy the task suite into /tests during image construction.

defect: The grader patches only url_fetcher.urlopen, rejecting reasonable fixes that preserve behavior but use urllib custom openers.
evidence: tests/test_outputs.py patches url_fetcher.urlopen, while attempts 01, 03-11 fail redirect/allowed-fetch checks primarily because their custom opener bypasses that private mock rather than because the reported final URL is accepted.
change: Patch both supported urllib transport entry points in the semantic response tests so module-level urlopen and OpenerDirector-based implementations receive the same controlled response.
